description: Source code for a Spark Structured Streaming example that performs complex sessionization of network events, demonstrating session windowing with custom logic including handling of event types and timeouts.

classes.name: SessionEvent
classes.description: Represents an individual user event with timestamps and event type.

classes.name: SessionAcc
classes.description: Accumulates events into a session, providing start and end times, and supports merging sessions.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Represents the output session information with user id, duration, and event count.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Constructs a SessionEvent from userId, eventTypeStr, timestamp, and gapDuration.
